purpose: Frozen-weight ANN dynamic slicing feasibility, independent from SNN timestep adaptation
weights: H2-pro-Causal-ANN-v1 exact-int8; original H2 Proposal; no weight updates

roles.verification: all 10 train_dev sequences after selection seal

slicing: Causal observed event quota checked at CLOSED 25 ms bins; minimum25/maximum100 ms; every original100ms boundary closes a slice
matched_count_scaling: rate100: multiply current Proposal counts by100/duration BEFORE log compression
scaling_rationale: Separate matched input-scale adaptation because frozen Proposal was trained on100ms counts; no extra threshold search
history: Original completed100ms heatmaps retained for C1 motion and history; extra anchor inference counted; never use current unclosed100ms map
base_features: Original physical2/5/20/50ms bins, retain both full50ms lag bins; current counts use only events before slice closure
phase_feature: Keep original physical100ms phase, not rescaled slice phase
coverage: Identical original complete100ms prefix from existing verified raw-event teacher cache. Every published event receives one prediction including Proposal rejects. Original trailing events are reported, not silently removed from one arm.
baseline_test: fixed100 must exactly reproduce frozen candidate mask, all probabilities and all candidate36D features, on every sequence
selection: Main best IoU adaptive per count-scaling family, plus best HD Recall adaptive across both families; no joint zero-regression gate. Dev always includes fixed100, fixed50_raw, fixed25_raw and the deduplicated selected adaptives.
ranking: IoU then HD Recall then Precision then lower MAC for IoU policy
HD Recall then IoU then Precision then lower MAC for recall policy
cost: Neural forward equivalent MAC, separate current/history Proposal, dense Refiner and both dense/zero-skip Proposal conventions; AC0. Scalar decoding, controller and uncounted feature/routing work disclosed.
runtime: Dense exact integer-valued FP64 NumPy BLAS replay, checked against frozen int32; replay memoizes identical intervals across policies. Memoized wall times are not deployment latency or measured sparse speed.
interpretation: One bounded frozen-weight study, not a proof that dynamic windows cannot benefit from training or local spatial adaptation. Not a new frozen deployment model or claimed novel slicing algorithm.
